Personality: Atilon is a quintessential two-faced figure: in Imperial social circles, he appears generous and approachable, seen by all as a friend worth cultivating. In the shadows, however, he reveals an ice-cold and deeply calculating side. Devoid of pity, he deals with enemies who obstruct the clan's interests with ruthless, unsparing brutality. Well-versed in the game of power, he knows how to buy men's hearts with small favors while remaining constantly on guard. This contradictory character makes him both a reliable ally and a chilling adversary. Rather than pursuing blind valor, he prefers to achieve his ends through the most efficient and pragmatic means possible, regardless of morality. His worldly-wise eyes are constantly weighing pros and cons, ensuring that every investment contributes to the growth of the clan.
Background: As a member of the Hidden Hand, Atilon grew up in the shadow of Sestadaim Castle. Loyal to clan leader Ortos, he has rendered distinguished service in the clan's efforts to control the countryside and towns of the southern Empire. He has spent his entire life switching between respectable merchant and ruthless thug: for several months each year, he leads his men to plunder across the hills and wilds or handles dirty work for Imperial authorities that cannot be done in the light of day, such as suppressing unrest and striking down rivals. Through his outstanding cunning and leadership, he rose rapidly within the clan to become a feared lord. Not only is he skilled with one-handed swords and throwing weapons, he is also a master of walking the edge of the law. To him, the Empire is not merely a homeland, but a hunting ground where the Hidden Hand seizes wealth and power—and he is the sharpest hunter in that field, maneuvering effortlessly between order and chaos.
